# Iteration 1 {.unnumbered}

<!-- This file is the source of a page on the course website. Read it there: https://ai.buas.nl/open-courses/introduction-to-ml/datalab/iteration-1/00_overview.html -->

The aim of this iteration is to build your first models for the project: a classification model, a regression model and a clustering model. They don't have to be good yet. What matters is that you go through the whole workflow once, from the problem to working models.

This iteration is highly guided. In later iterations, you will revisit these steps in greater depth and make increasingly more decisions yourself.

## The starter dataset

You work with `starter_dataset.xlsx`, a dataset of 80 molecules that is ready to use. Every row is one molecule:

| Column | Contains |
|---|---|
| A (`smiles`) | The SMILES string of the molecule |
| B to HJ | 217 molecular descriptors computed with RDKit: the features |
| HK to HM (`homo`, `lumo`, `stability`) | The three targets |

The dataset is prepared so that you can almost use it as it is: the descriptors are your features `X`, and each target is a `y`. In Self-study Theme 1 you trained models this way on small public datasets. Now you do the same on the project data.

## Complete the pages and notebooks

Work through the following pages **in order**:

1. [Business Understanding](01_business_understanding.qmd)
2. [Data Understanding](02_data_understanding.qmd)
3. [Classification](03_classification.ipynb)
4. [Regression](04_regression.ipynb)
5. [Clustering](05_clustering.ipynb)

Once you have completed all three notebooks, you have finished your first machine-learning cycle.

In [Iteration 2](../iteration-2/00_overview.qmd), after Self-study Theme 2, you revisit the workflow in greater depth.
